issues: 正视的 17×9 平面点阵铺满画面，像一张静态图案，没有空间感
波只是点的放大和变亮，读作「闪」而不是「波」
全片只有蓝色点和深蓝底，没有主体、没有文字，结尾不知道这一拍在说什么
第二道波和第一道波颜色接近（蓝 / 青），回执感弱
changes: look 换成 aurora（深紫夜 + 紫光 + 粉色点缀），点阵改成一张铺向地平线的透视 LED 地面，约 2,100 个点按真实透视近大远小、远处渐隐
波变成真的波：波前经过时点被抬起（近处 ~60px crest）+ scale 过冲到 1.5 + 提亮到近白光晕，之后留在常亮紫
波源是地面中央的能量核：0–8f 先蓄能（预备）再放波，第一道 1.3f/格外扩，第二道粉色脉冲 0.9f/格向内越收越急
汇聚时核爆亮 + 软边竖向光柱 + 外扩回执环，随后天空区 120px 标题「Every node, online.」逐词由虚到实，等宽副标计数到 2,048
时长 114f→156f，汇聚后留标题揭示 + 30f 呼吸定格
issuesEn: A front-on flat 17x9 dot grid filled the frame like a static pattern with no sense of space
The wave was just dots growing and brightening, so it read as a flash rather than a wave
Only blue dots on navy with no subject or text; at the end it was unclear what the beat was saying
The second wave's colour (cyan) was close to the first (blue), so the 'reply' read weakly
changesEn: Aurora look (deep violet night, violet light, pink accent); the grid becomes a perspective LED floor running to the horizon, ~2,100 dots scaled by true perspective and fading in the distance
The wave is a real wave: passing dots lift (a ~60px crest up close), overshoot to 1.5x and flare to near-white halos, then stay lit violet
The source is an energy core on the floor: it charges for 0-8f, then fires; wave one expands at 1.3f per cell, wave two (pink) converges at 0.9f per cell, speeding up as it closes
On convergence the core flares with a soft vertical beam and an expanding echo ring, then the 120px headline 'Every node, online.' resolves word by word with a mono counter running to 2,048
114f to 156f, leaving room for the headline reveal and a 30f breathing hold
